name: Parity multisig wallet reinitialization
summary: The wallet forwarded unmatched calls to a shared WalletLibrary whose public initWallet function lacked a one-time initialization guard. An attacker could call it again through the wallet, replace the initialized owner set with their own address, and then execute an authorized drain.
notes: The wallet deployment immutably selected WalletLibrary 0xa657491c1e7f16adb39b9b60e87bbb8d93988bc3 in its runtime; both runtimes remained unchanged through the selected exploit transaction.

OpenZeppelin's contemporaneous analysis reports 153,037 ETH drained from three affected multisigs, worth approximately $30 million. The three drain calls transfer 26,793 ETH, 44,055 ETH, and 82,189 ETH, respectively; the USD figure is the report's rounded incident estimate.
The $30 million loss is a rounded contemporaneous report for the exact 153,037 ETH drained across the campaign.
